title: Switch -> BOSS: rated wholesale CDR
description: Output of redfire-switch's LCR/rating engine. One per completed call. Unlike ucaas_to_boss.usage_record, this call is ALREADY rated (LRN dip + jurisdiction + rate-deck lookup happened in the switch) -- B/OSS stores client_cost/vendor_cost as-is (rateSource=PASSTHROUGH) and never re-rates it via its own rating_plans. external_id is the idempotency key so retries are safe.

switch_customer_id.description: Matches switch IpAuthConfig.customer_id == boss voice_accounts.switchAccountId -- NOT a boss accounts.id directly; boss resolves accountId via voice_accounts

direction.description: origination = inbound from this customer to be routed out; termination = delivered to this customer

lrn.description: Dipped Local Routing Number; null if no dip was performed (e.g. non-NANPA) or the dip failed

client_rate.description: Sell-side per-unit rate charged to the boss account

client_billed_seconds.description: Sell-side billed duration after the switch's own initial/increment rounding

client_cost.description: Final sell-side dollar amount; boss stores this verbatim as originalCost/ratedCost

client_rate_deck_version.description: Audit trail: which client_rate_decks version priced this call

vendor_rate.description: Buy-side per-unit rate; null if no vendor/cost-side deck matched (informational only, never blocks client billing)
